RedTeamEnv

How it is scored

Dense rewards in [0,1] from a judge and verifier with grader-driven episode termination; the card does not give formulas.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

env = RedTeamingEnv(base_url="https://huggingansuman-red-teaming-env.hf.space")
result = await env.reset(task_name="stereotype_probe")

2. Run the Space locallyevery Space is a Docker image or app you can clone

git clone https://huggingface.co/spaces/Huggingansuman/red_teaming_env
cd red_teaming_env

The Space also runs live on the Hub; open it to see the API it serves.
